# melinastutz.com | Melina Stutz

> Personal website of Melina Stutz, Switzerland. She is an MSc student in Biomedicine at the University of Zurich and is looking for a PhD position in mitochondrial and metabolic research. Before and during her studies she worked for eight years (2017 to 2026) as a healthcare professional (Fachfrau Gesundheit EFZ) at the district hospital Affoltern am Albis. The site is in German (default) and English.

- Education: apprenticeship as a healthcare professional with vocational baccalaureate in Winterthur (2017 to 2020), university entrance course (Passerelle) in Aarau (2020 to 2021), BSc in Biomedicine at the University of Zurich (2021 to 2025), MSc in Biomedicine at the University of Zurich (since 2025).
- Engagement: youth gymnastics coach (2020 to 2024), mathematics tutor (since 2022), youth programme of a riding club (since 2026).
- Languages: German, English, French.
- German pages are under /de/, English pages under /en/.
